note: Attacker-controlled input file is opened and its raw bytes are read as the XML payload for the AMF importer.
The attacker-supplied bytes are parsed as XML; the malformed document (mismatched end tag) yields a non-status_ok parse result, so parse() returns false.
On XML parse failure the heap-allocated XmlParser is deleted but the member pointer mXmlParser is never reset to nullptr, leaving it dangling.

code: throw DeadlyImportError("Failed to create XML reader for file" + pFile + ".");
note: The import aborts with DeadlyImportError; the AMFImporter instance still holding the dangling mXmlParser survives for later cleanup.
Importer cleanup destroys the AMFImporter; the destructor deletes the already-freed mXmlParser a second time, re-entering the XmlParser destructor on freed memory.
The second delete invokes ~TXmlParser() -> clear(); mData.resize(0) performs a heap-use-after-free read while resizing the internal data vector of the freed XmlParser object.
